title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage In-Term Changes: Storage, Deductible Changes and Removal
content:
## Storage

A vehicle may be put in storage when the customer expects it to be off the road for at least the storage minimum (30 days on every deductible option). In storage, collision is suspended and comprehensive stays in force, and no claim for a collision loss during storage is covered. Storage ends on the day the customer asks to drive the vehicle again. A financed or leased vehicle may be put in storage, but its physical damage cannot be removed while the loss payee is on the coverage.

## Deductible changes

- A deductible increase takes effect today or a later date the customer chooses within the auto endorsement window.
- A deductible decrease takes effect only after a new photo inspection is accepted; every option of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage requires that inspection.
- A deductible change never applies to a loss that occurred before its effective date.

*Hypothetical:* a customer lowers the deductible from the $1,000 option to the $500 option; the new photo inspection is accepted on day 5. A loss on day 3 is decided under the $1,000 option; a loss on day 7 under the $500 option.

## Removal

Physical damage is removed:
- when the customer asks, unless a loss payee is on it;
- when the vehicle is removed from the policy;
- when the auto package no longer allows physical damage; or
- when a total-loss settlement is paid.

Removing physical damage also removes the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option on the vehicle.

| Removal ground | Loss payee on the coverage | Removed |
|---|---|---|
| Customer request | No | Yes |
| Customer request | Yes | No |
| Vehicle removed from the policy | Either | Yes |
| Package no longer allows physical damage | Either | Yes |
| Total-loss settlement paid | Either | Yes |
